_comment: Pinned upstream inputs for the runtime bundle. release-runtime.yml downloads
exactly these URLs and refuses to continue unless the bytes hash to sha256.
UE4SS publishes experimental builds under the MOVING tag 'experimental-latest'.
The asset filename carries the build's git hash, so when that tag moves, the URL
below 404s and the release fails loudly. That is deliberate: bumping UE4SS is a
decision, not something a release should do on its own.
To bump: pick the new asset, put its URL and sha256 here, run the workflow, then
verify in game that all four AOBs still resolve (see signatures/README.md).
_known_good_note: The build currently verified in game is NOT this one. Its UE4SS.dll hashes to
longer downloadable — experimental-latest has moved past it. The only surviving
copies are the developer's install and modpack/latest/modpack.zip in R2, which
has no versioned path, so the next modpack upload destroys the last copy.
then point artifacts.ue4ss at that immutable URL and drop the moving-tag dependency.
